value.rationale: A full sharp finite-moment classification for a canonical two-parameter family of curved spherical regions is a substantive geometric inverse result. The two-moment fold and sharp latitude window, coupled with a universally separating third moment, are nontrivial structural obstructions/resolutions with natural shape-calibration implications. The theorem states no general domain reconstruction, and neither an isolated numeric constant nor computational reproducibility alone establishes its value.
